entities.summary: Comic LO , abbreviated as LO, is a Japanese lolicon-focused erotic manga magazine. The magazine has been published by Akane Shinsha since the October 2002 issue released on September 20, 2002, and was published irregularly until May 2004, when it became a monthly magazine. In August 2023, the magazine became bimonthly. The "LO" stands for "lolita only", reflecting its focus on fictional young girl characters. The Magazine has since become a staple of lolicon subculture, inspiring offshoots magazines such as Towako.
